requirement.statement: Codument SHALL author XNL examples, generated XNL, and XNL fixtures using canonical XNL structure semantics.

case.given: 一个 XNL 节点包含普通业务或知识属性，例如 kind、fact_grade、single_writer、priority 或 status
case.when: 系统生成或修订该节点
case.then: 系统 SHALL put the properties in the `{}` attribute block
case.and: 系统 SHALL reserve metadata for system-level parser/tooling fields

case.given: 测试资源保留 legacy metadata 写法用于兼容性覆盖
case.then: 系统 SHALL label or isolate it as legacy compatibility coverage

case.given: 一个 XNL DSL 节点包含只出现一次的语义槽位，例如 question、answer、rationale 或 evidence
case.then: 系统 SHALL put singleton semantic slots in the `()` extend block

case.given: 一个 decision tree 节点包含下级 decision 节点集合
case.then: 系统 SHALL put child decision nodes in the `[]` array block

case.given: 未来新增 XNL 规范示例或 fixture
case.when: 普通属性被写进 metadata 或单例槽位被写进 `[]`
case.then: 系统 SHOULD fail a focused test or lint check unless the file is explicitly legacy compatibility coverage
